content.author: Jules
content.body: Okay so, tell me again about the hash bars.

content.author: Vincent
content.body: Okay what do you want to know?

content.author: Jules
content.body: Well, hash is legal over there, right?

content.author: Vincent
content.body: Yeah, It's legal but it ain't hundred percent legal, I mean, you just can't walk into a restaurant, roll a joint and start puffin' away. They want you to smoke in your home or certain designated places.

content.author: Jules
content.body: And those are the hash bars?

content.author: Vincent
content.body: Yeah, It breaks down like this, ok, it's legal to buy it, it's legal to own it, and if you're the proprietor of a hash bar, it's legal to sell it. It's legal to carry it, but...but that dosen't matter, cause, get a load of this; all right, if you get stopped by a cop in Amsterdam, it's illegal for them to search you. I mean that's a right the cops in Amsterdam don't have.

content.author: Jules
content.body: Oh, man, I'm goin', that's all there is to it. I'm fuckin' goin'.

content.author: Vincent
content.body: I know, baby, you'd dig it the most.. But you know what the funniest thing about Europe is?

content.author: Jules
content.body: What?

content.author: Vincent
content.body: It's the little differences. A lotta the same shit we got here, they got there, but there they're a little different.

content.author: Jules
content.body: Example?

content.author: Vincent
content.body: Alright, when you .... into a movie theatre in Amsterdam, you can buy beer. And I don't mean in a paper cup either. They give you a glass of beer. And in Paris, you can buy beer at MacDonald's. And you know what they call a Quarter Pounder with Cheese in Paris?

content.author: Jules
content.body: They don't call it a Quarter Pounder with Cheese?

content.author: Vincent
content.body: No, they got the metric system there, they wouldn't know what the fuck a Quarter Pounder is.

content.author: Jules
content.body: What'd they call it?

content.author: Vincent
content.body: They call it Royale with Cheese.

content.author: Jules
content.body: Royale with Cheese. What'd they call a Big Mac?

content.author: Vincent
content.body: Big Mac's a Big Mac, but they call it Le Big Mac.

content.author: Jules
content.body: Le big Mac! Ahhaha, what do they call a Whopper?

content.author: Vincent
content.body: I dunno, I didn't go into a Burger King. But you know what they put on french fries in Holland instead of ketchup?

content.author: Jules
content.body: What?

content.author: Vincent
Jules
content.body: Goddamn!

content.author: Vincent
content.body: I seen 'em do it man, they fuckin' drown 'em in it.

content.author: Jules
content.body: Uuccch!
